2008–2018 · My early foundation

The Hebrew Academy

Ten formative years at the Bess and Paul Sigel Hebrew Academy of Greater Hartford, from Nursery 4 through eighth grade.

A Decade of Growing Up

I attended the Hebrew Academy from 2008 to 2018. That span covered Nursery 4, Kindergarten, elementary school, and middle school: a lot of my earliest learning, and a lot of growing up.

Over the decade, a handful of teachers became familiar parts of my school life. These were formative years, with the first lessons, school routines, and personal experiences that came before high school.

Secular & Judaic Studies

The way the curriculum was organized changed somewhat from year to year. Broadly, some classes focused on secular subjects, while others focused on Judaic learning.

Secular Studies

Math, science, English, music, computers, physical education, and other general school subjects.

Judaic Studies

Hebrew, prayers, the Torah, and other aspects of Jewish learning.

Looking Back on Those Years

A decade of childhood comes with plenty of learning beyond the curriculum. There were teachers I remember, experiences I want to revisit, and plenty of awkward or immature moments that I now look back on and cringe at.

This is the beginning of an account of those years. Individual memories, stories, and pieces of schoolwork can fill in more of the picture over time.
